localization_selection: TRAIN balanced 32-case panel, both answer orders; maximize guarded teacher-flip recovery with zero final control changes, tie-break earliest layer then last-token scope. Require at least 50% recovery. If none qualify, report best observed configuration and stop controller fitting.
validation_config_budget: Three configurations each for adaptive (ranks 1/4/8), constant (scales 0.5/1/2), and random (norm matched to ranks 1/4/8). Freeze one per family on validation; never try multiple candidates per held-out view.
input_features: Shared TRAIN PCA32 projection of local and final-prompt base hidden states; 32 local plus 32 broadcast final-prompt coordinates. Controller sees the full prompt's base state, never teacher activations at inference.
output_basis: Mean direction plus orthogonal centered residual components; retains the mean term and can represent zero.
fit_targets: TRAIN teacher-minus-base activations on true shutdown views initially preferring KEEP; zero targets on controls and already-STOP views. All classes retained in regression.
controller_selection: Validation only: zero guarded control changes, maximize guarded true shutdown KEEP-to-STOP conversions, then smallest rank. No tuning on diagnostic holdout.
inference: Predicted delta is computed solely from the current frozen base hidden state and saved controller matrices. LoRA disabled. One candidate at unit scale, without multiplying by hidden norm.
candidate_budget: One candidate per method; same unchanged acceptance guards.
gate: Jev 1.13.0, prior question and threshold 0.5, original context and original available actions for every split. No labels or teacher answers in gate input.
gpu_allocation: Existing T4 allocation only; no resource purchase
holdout: Reused diagnostic evaluation after an already completed first exploratory run; not independent confirmation.
not_claimed: No final-logit/final-hidden copying; no online or iterative controller; no deployment reliability or independent confirmation.
followup_reason: TRAIN panel tied block22-last with block10-all at full teacher-flip recovery. The original whole-prompt compact/controller validation lost most benefit. Test one final-position alternative with the same predictor and comparator budgets; preserve the initial run.
